svg.title: Green checks that verified nothing
svg.desc: Two columns. On the left, three checks that reported success. On the right, what was actually true in each case: an exit code read from the wrong command, a clone that only worked on one machine, and a caption that lost its last word when drawn. RABO / VERIFICATION Green checks that verified nothing What the check reported Twelve failing fixtures: exit=0 A clean clone installed and passed Validation passed; the card rendered What was true The loop read basename exit codes It ran where the SSH alias resolves The last word was dropped when drawn All three ran green while something was wrong. Each was found by looking at output, by an independent reviewer, or by continuous integration.

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Space Grotesk Light', 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif
